judgments.rationale: The proposal merely populates the optional action field with 'deem' and rephrases 'must' to 'is required to' in the summary. Under the guidelines, an edit is unnecessary when it only copies meaning already expressed in the summary into an empty optional field, even with rephrasing.

The source sets out the disqualification criteria disjunctively ('unless he— (1) ...; or (5) ...'). Changing the qualification condition to 'unless all of the following are true' joined by 'and' fundamentally alters the legal standard, incorrectly requiring a person to satisfy every disqualifying condition simultaneously to be deemed not qualified.
